title: C1739 — Variable Camshaft Timing Bank 2 Solenoid 1 (VCT21)
introduction:
Variable camshaft timing adjusts valve-opening and valve-closing timing as the engine runs. The controller and control solenoids work with oil-controlled actuators to make those changes. Here I follow the electrical connection: the cavity labels join the housing drawing to the circuit table, like matching a name on a door to the right entry in a directory.

Use the connector identity, outline and shell information together. The component title and circuit Function wording remain as printed; their naming relationship is unexplained. This is an identification reference, with no engine-fitment assignment, physical viewing direction, electrical test or replacement sequence. Gauge conventions and the Size and Used codes are not defined.
